fields.brief_description: Matchall helps users draft needs and offers, review matching opportunities, and exchange private contact details only after both sides agree. Review each draft before activating matching. Intents stay private unless the user separately approves public visibility. Pause matching when plans change. Matchall does not place orders or process payments.
fields.testing_instructions: Use the reviewed source revision and configure the matchall MCP server at https://matchall.net/amatch/v2 in Grok Bot through its supported development connector flow. Complete OAuth in the host UI with a dedicated test account; do not put passwords, codes or tokens in chat. Discover tools and call get_profile first. Test a synthetic standing-desk need: save a draft with separate synthetic contact details, inspect it, then explicitly approve confirmation and activation while keeping it private. With a separate compatible demo seller, inspect actual matches, request contact exchange only after reviewing the current contact version, and accept the selected incoming request from its receiving account before reading mutually authorized contacts. Pause the buyer intent and verify its returned state. Reject payment, non-consensual contact export and unsupported complete-account-erasure requests. The repository documents five positive and three negative cases. Public-feed publication and real transactions are not part of these tests. Record development setup, OAuth and actual native calls. The dated report records all eight cases passing through a development connection and source skill; marketplace installation remains unverified.
